title: The GOATs of Philosophy
subtitle: A parody Joe Rogan Experience episode
author: Andries J. Greyling
logline: Joe asks Jamie to run down history's GOATs of philosophy, ten condensed minutes each, before today's guest walks in: real philosopher-podcaster Alex O'Connor, for a genuinely long, wandering, three-hour conversation about God, free will, ethics, and what DMT might or might not prove.
blueprint: not a book: an outline + a fully-written representative excerpt, not a full transcript (a real 3-hour episode would run 25,000-40,000+ words)
real_person_note: Alex O'Connor is a real, living public philosopher/podcaster. His dialogue here is fictional parody, written to be consistent with his well-documented real public positions (see STYLE_GUIDE.md sourcing), but no line attributed to him is an actual quote. Joe Rogan and Jamie Vernon are portrayed in the same fictional-parody spirit, consistent with their public on-air personas.
